title: POV: You Wait 24 Hours Before Buying… and Keep $1,140 a Year 🛒

lines: Eleven P M. A jacket on sale. Only two left!
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail in bed at night staring at a shopping app on her phone with a flashing sale banner, excited face, vertical composition

lines: Mia buys it in ten seconds. Tags still on, three months later.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail looking at a closet full of clothes with price tags still attached, guilty face, vertical composition

lines: You? One rule. Twenty four hours.
scenes.img: {HERO} on a couch adding a jacket to an online cart on his phone, calm face, vertical composition

lines: Add to cart. Close the app. Go to sleep.
scenes.img: {HERO} putting his phone face down on a nightstand and turning off the lamp, peaceful smile, vertical composition

lines: Next morning, you don't even want it.
scenes.img: {HERO} looking at his phone in the morning with a puzzled shrug, coffee in hand, vertical composition

lines: Most late night carts just quietly expire.
scenes.img: an online shopping cart icon fading away into dust on a phone screen held by a man in a mustard sweater, vertical composition

lines: Ninety five dollars a month? That's eleven hundred forty a year.
scenes.img: {HERO} dropping cash into a glass savings jar on a kitchen table, satisfied smile, vertical composition

lines: Follow for more. Because tonight at eleven, another sale is coming.
scenes.img: {HERO} giving a thumbs up to the viewer in a bright living room, friendly smile, vertical composition
